research_question: What do Circle's latest public USDC issuance and redemption data imply for stablecoin liquidity, and what does it not establish about XRPL or XRP?

key_findings.interpretation: Circle's issuer-level USDC circulation contracted over the displayed 7-day, 30-day and 365-day windows as of October 29, 2026. Gross issuance and redemption are large in both directions; the displayed net changes are the more relevant supply-delta features. This is a global issuer measure, not XRPL supply or XRP capital flow.
limits: The transparency dashboard aggregates USDC across supported chains.
The $70.0B circulation and $71.4B reserves are not XRPL-specific.
Net global USDC circulation change does not identify the chain, venue, wallet, holder or asset receiving redeemed fiat.
A decline in USDC circulation does not prove XRP outflows, and a rise would not prove XRP inflows.
The dashboard reports rounded figures; displayed annual net change may not equal subtraction of rounded issued and redeemed totals.

claims: Circle describes USDC as natively issued on 38 blockchains.
Circle Mint supports institutional minting/redemption and cross-chain movement across supported networks.
limits: A multichain transfer capability does not imply XRP is the intermediary.
No chain-specific XRPL supply or crosschain route volume is inferred from the global dashboard.

relationship_edges.relation: global aggregate includes multiple chains; XRPL component not isolated by this dashboard
institutional mint/redemption and documented multichain movement
USDC distribution economics depend partly on balances held on Coinbase platforms
relationship_edges.classification: SEC_filing; detailed separately in Q2 2026 crosswalk

competing_hypotheses.claim: A sustained global USDC circulation contraction could indicate a reduction in dollar-stablecoin liquidity available to crypto markets.
competing_hypotheses.support: Circle's official dashboard shows negative displayed net circulation changes over 7, 30 and 365 days.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limit: Other stablecoins, fiat balances, bank credit, derivatives collateral and chain-specific flows are not included. The change may reflect issuer, regulatory, seasonal or portfolio-specific factors.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase may retain or grow a larger share of USDC distribution even during global USDC contraction.
competing_hypotheses.support: Coinbase reported record Q3 average USDC balances; Circle's SEC filing links distributor economics to platform balances.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limit: Coinbase's Q3 average and Circle's October 29 point-in-time global circulation are different periods and measurement types. A synchronized share series is required.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Global USDC contraction predicts XRP price weakness.
competing_hypotheses.support: Stablecoin liquidity can be a broad crypto-market condition.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limit: No synchronized XRP market, exchange, derivatives, ETF, macro and competing stablecoin features or calibrated out-of-sample evidence is supplied here.

feature_admission.circle_global_usdc_circulation: Issuer-level global supply feature only; preserve as-of date and issuer scope.
feature_admission.circle_global_usdc_net_issuance: Issuer-level net circulation delta feature; use displayed rounded net change and retain gross issuance/redemption separately.
feature_admission.xrpl_usdc_supply: Not admitted from global Circle dashboard; requires pinned-ledger issuer/holder reconciliation.
feature_admission.coinbase_usdc_share: Not admitted from non-synchronized Q3 average Coinbase balance and October 29 global circulation; require same-period measurements.
feature_admission.xrp_price_forecast: No directional forecast from this artifact.

next_actions: Build a daily, synchronized issuer-level USDC circulation and issuance/redemption series.
Separate global USDC supply from chain-specific issuer balances, transfers, minting, redemption and crosschain movement.
Align Coinbase average/period-end USDC balances with Circle's same-period global supply before estimating distribution share.
Compare USDC with USDT and other major stablecoin net issuance, exchange reserves, derivatives collateral and fiat funding.
Test lagged relationships with XRP spot liquidity, order-book depth, futures basis/funding, ETF flows and realized returns using walk-forward evaluation.
